title: Product Price at a Given Date
rawStatement: missing: not in local-reference/leetcode/raw (index marks Missing)
summary: Return each product's price as of 2019-08-16, using its latest change on or before that date. Products with no qualifying change have price 10. Products whose first change comes after the date are included with price 10.
inputFormat: Products(product_id, new_price, change_date): one row per price change, keyed by (product_id, change_date).
outputFormat: Columns product_id and price; one row per product that ever appears in Products, plus default-price products.
tieRules: The latest change_date on or before 2019-08-16 wins; a change on exactly 2019-08-16 counts.
edgeRules: Products whose first change is after 2019-08-16 get 10. The default price is 10 per the draft.
